title.narrative: Support the National Strategic Plan for elimination of malaria and prevention of re-introduction in Bhutan 2020-2025 - Bhutan (01-Jul-2021-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Bhutan, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Royal Government of Bhutan (MOH)This program has the following goals: To achieve zero indigenous malaria by 2022 and WHO certificate by 2025. The objectives of this program are: To strengthen surveillance and monitoring to prevent re-establishment of malaria. To strengthen RSSH to sustain malaria elimination
